main_measure.name: mean 20-bar forward return when forecast > 0 minus mean of all blocks in same coin-windows
main_measure.threshold: excess > 0 with t >= 2 confirms; excess < 0 with t <= -2 rejects; otherwise inconclusive

supporting_check.name: hit rate of 20-bar returns when forecast > 0 minus unconditional hit rate

decided_by: The t-statistic lies between -2 and 2, so the result is inconclusive.
reading: Blocks start at positions 0, 20, 40, ... of each window with a full 20-bar return inside it; 'the same coin-windows' is read as the coin-windows holding at least one forecast > 0 block, and the excess is tested with Welch's t between the forecast > 0 blocks and all blocks of those windows.
